title_zh: 黄果树瀑布:云雾中的层叠水幕
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (19/20): Huangguoshu Waterfall, Curtains of Water in the Mist
note_en: 还没…就… says the second thing happens surprisingly early, before the first has even finished: 游客还没走近，就能听到远处传来的轰鸣声 "Before visitors even get close, they can already hear a roar in the distance." English needs "before... even" or "already" to get this across, while Chinese simply pairs 还没 ("not yet") with 就, which stresses how soon the result comes; Xiao Zhou's last thought uses it too: 还没来得及好好告别，心里就已经盼着下一次归来.
